title: 71 Million Contracts A Day: Is This The New Retail Standard?
speaker: Henry Schwarz (Cboe) with tastylive host

macro_themes.view: Options running ~71M contracts/day, retail >60% of activity; Q3 growth leveled off in a range-bound market.
Low correlation/high dispersion dampens index moves while single stocks swing; consumer names beaten down by high rates.
Cboe launches 7:30-9:25 ET pre-market options on 27 top names from Monday; mind liquidity and spreads.

calls.reason: Host rotating out of tech into beaten-down consumer staples as only ~25% of S&P names were above the 50-day MA; tech to weaken.
calls.quote: I'm gonna get starting to get long some of these, whether it's the Walmarts, the Cokes, the Pepsis
